outfit.name: 大荒农业天师原作衣装
outfit.prose: her original white long jacket with cobalt-blue lining, gold cord fastenings and an off-shoulder fit over a gray-and-white strapless top, a white belt, wide white trousers with ocher illustrated hem panels, black ankle boots, long tassel earrings, a necklace of geometric bronze blocks and pale bead bracelets
